## Research themes

The portfolio spans hydrological modelling, rainfall and streamflow extremes, precipitation-product uncertainty, streamflow reconstruction, catchment similarity, hydroclimatic variability and statistical inference. The thematic radar is being revalidated for the expanded portfolio; no scores are shown here until all 14 manuscript profiles have been assessed consistently.
